subject: Staggered priming & rerank evaluation orchestration — Atlas Commerce onboarding
messages:
From: Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.com>
To: Alex Reyes <alex@atlascommerce.com>; Priya Sinha <priya.s@atlascommerce.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Naomi Feldman <naomi_feldman@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-08-10T09:17:00-07:00
Subject: Staggered priming & rerank evaluation orchestration — Atlas Commerce onboarding

Hi Alex / Priya,

Great to meet you both last week. Per our kickoff, I wanted to propose a staggered index priming approach to get your search+rerank stack warmed without blocking product traffic. High-level plan below — please confirm the data slice cadence and any sequencing constraints from your side.

Plan summary (proposal):
- Week 0 (prep): Atlas provides a 50k sample CSV (first 10M token look) so we can validate embeddings and field mapping.
- Week 1 (wave 1): Seed 200k documents into a dedicated vector namespace; run rerank smoke tests on a 1k prompt suite.
- Week 2 (wave 2): Backfill an additional 800k documents; enable live A/B rerank traffic at 5% with metrics collection.
- Week 3+: Increment to 25% then 100% as QA passes.

Open questions for Atlas:
1) Can DataOps deliver a CSV extract with the canonical text fields + canonical_id by Friday (2026-08-13)?
2) Any documents that must be excluded for compliance or PII reasons?
3) Are there existing rerank labels or human judgments we can use for initial eval?

Attachments: sample file format and a skeleton priming schedule attached.

Next step: once you confirm the CSV cadence and excluded categories, Marissa will run a dry-run embedding pass and share token/cost estimates.

Thanks,
Jordan Blake
Senior Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
jordan_blake@redwood.com | +1 415-555-0192

Attachments: atlas-index-sample-rows.csv (csv), staggered-priming-schedule.xlsx (xlsx)
From: Alex Reyes <alex@atlascommerce.com>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.com>
Cc: Priya Sinha <priya.s@atlascommerce.com>, DataOps Team <dataops@atlascommerce.com>
Date: 2026-08-10T11:02:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Staggered priming & rerank evaluation orchestration — Atlas Commerce onboarding

Jordan — thanks, this looks sensible. Quick answers:
- We can produce the 50k sample by EOD Thursday (2026-08-13) — DataOps will drop it to the Drive link.
- Exclusions: two legal-sensitive doc types (contract drafts and SSNs) — we will flag those with a drop-in exclude column.
- Rerank labels: we have ~1.5k human judgments from a prior relevance study; we can share a CSV of (query, doc_id, label).

One ask: for the wave sizes, are the 200k/800k numbers flexible? We might prefer 100k/400k initially to reduce token burn while we verify scoring drift.

Alex
Head of Search & Discovery | Atlas Commerce
alex@atlascommerce.com

Date: 2026-08-11T08:45:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Staggered priming & rerank evaluation orchestration — Atlas Commerce onboarding

Thanks Alex — we can absolutely tighten the wave sizes. Proposed adjusted cadence:
- Wave 1: 100k seed (sanity checks + embedding cost estimate)
- Wave 2: 300k backfill (rerank A/B at 5%)
- Wave 3: remainder in 2x batches to reach full coverage

Deliverables from Redwood after each wave:
- Embedding histogram (by length) and token/cost estimate
- Rerank smoke test report (precision@k, failure cases, sample queries)
- Rollback checklist & snapshot of vector namespace prior to next wave

I'll run the dry-run on the sample once it's uploaded and post results to the Drive folder. Naomi / Karthik — can you confirm the rerank eval harness will accept Atlas' 1.5k judgments CSV as-is or do we need normalization?

Marissa Cole
CS Implementation Lead | Redwood Inference
marissa_cole@redwood.com

Attachments: rerank-smoke-test-prompts.md (md)
From: Naomi Feldman <naomi_feldman@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, Alex Reyes <alex@atlascommerce.com>
Date: 2026-08-12T10:10:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Staggered priming & rerank evaluation orchestration — Atlas Commerce onboarding

Alex — the 1.5k judgment set is a great starting point. We usually normalize labels to a 0-2 relevance scale; if Atlas uses a binary label, we can map 1 -> 1, 0 -> 0 and then sample a small verification set for quality. Two notes:

1) QA checks we'll run on the sample:
   - Field extraction parity (title/body/metadata)
   - Token-length distribution vs expected production sample
   - Embedding-space nearest-neighbor sanity (spot-check pairs)
2) Rerank harness expects queries in the JSONL format shown in the Drive link. I'll add a tiny script to convert Atlas' CSV to the harness format — will drop in the Drive folder by Thursday morning.

Also tagging Karthik: K, we'll want to run a small quantized-run candidate (int8) on the 100k seed to validate latency before wave 2. Can you schedule a 2-hour window next Monday?

Thanks,
Naomi Feldman
Applied ML | Redwood Inference
naomi_feldman@redwood.com
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
To: Naomi Feldman <naomi_feldman@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.com>, Alex Reyes <alex@atlascommerce.com>

Subject: Re: Staggered priming & rerank evaluation orchestration — Atlas Commerce onboarding

All — confirmed. I've booked a 2-hour validation slot for Monday 2026-08-17 09:00-11:00 PT on the dedicated cluster. Agenda:
- 09:00-09:25: Seed embeddings pass (100k) + histogram and token/cost report
- 09:25-09:50: Rerank smoke tests with Atlas judgment set (sanity metrics)
- 09:50-10:20: Int8 latency run and CPU/GPU profiling (KPI: 95th pct latency < 120ms for candidate generation)
- 10:20-11:00: Review results, capture rollback snapshots, and finalize wave 2 timing

Marissa — please confirm you have the staggered-priming-schedule.xlsx updated with the new smaller wave sizes; Alex / Priya — once you upload the sample CSV to the Drive link, I'll kick off the embedding pass and share logs.

Karthik Iyer
Inference Engineer | Redwood Inference
